summary: Server-only, saved (models game.crowds.v0/v1 16 bytes, v2 12 bytes align 4; no member names known). Lives on crowd character triggers (esv::CrowdCharacterTrigger), up to 212 holders, from level load on. Driven by esv::crowds::SpawnSystem::ProcessTriggers / SpawnCharacters (EoCServer.dll, CrowdCharacterSpawnSystem.cpp): a spawn timer per trigger, the number of characters it has spawned, and a flag that blocks spawning while players are near.

fields.name: SpawnInterval
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xD73760 ProcessTriggers: if (*(float*)(state+4) < *(float*)(state+0)) the trigger keeps waiting, otherwise it spawns; i.e. +0 is the time to wait before the next spawn (re-rolled with ls::Random). macOS Save copies 8 bytes (+0..+8) to the v2 model. Live floats 0 .. 24.6

fields.name: ElapsedTime
fields.evidence: ProcessTriggers: *(float*)(state+4) = deltaTime + *(float*)(state+4) when no blocking query matches; compared with +0. Live floats 0 .. 2910

fields.name: SpawnedCount
fields.evidence: SpawnCharacters EoCServer.dll+0xD74A30: *(ushort*)(state+8) + newCount <= trigger max (CrowdCharacterTrigger +0x7C scaled by crowd quality); ProcessTriggers compares the trigger's max with *(ushort*)(state+8). macOS Save copies a 2-byte value from +8. Live 0

fields.name: PlayersNearby
fields.evidence: ProcessTriggers: *(bool*)(state+10) = distance-to-players test (fVar27 < fVar30) and spawning is skipped while it is set; written from FUN_180d72950(players, transform). macOS Save copies one byte from +0xA. Live 0

open_questions: exact meaning of the bool at +0xA (players near / in view)
whether +0 is an interval or a target time; units seconds
